# Getting Started

> Start testing your MCP server in minutes
\
n> [!NOTE]\n>\n> SDK 10, CLI 6, Vitest 0.3, and later versions require an MCPJam login or `sk_` API key for every eval, including

BYOK runs with uploads disabled. Earlier versions keep their existing behavior.

## 1. Choose how to open Inspector

Every opt

ion below opens the MCPJam Inspector. Pick one based on where your MCP server runs.

> [card] [Web](https://app.mcpjam.com)
>
> No install. HTTPS servers only. Share servers with your team.\n\n> [card] [Terminal](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#ter

minal)
>
> `npx @mcpjam/inspector@latest`. Requires Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [macOS](https://docs.mcpjam.com

/installation.md#desktop-app)
>
> Desktop app (`.dmg`). No Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [Windows](https://docs.m

cpjam.com/installation.md#desktop-app)
>
> Desktop app (`.exe` installer). No Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [Dock
er](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#docker)\n>\n> Pull from Docker Hub. HTTP/S, plus STDIO servers that run inside the con

tainer.

* **Your server has a public HTTPS URL**: any option works. The web app needs no install.
* **Your server runs on `loc
alhost` or over STDIO**: use Terminal or the macOS or Windows desktop app. The web app can't reach it.\n* **You want Inspector iso
lated in a container**: use Docker. Reach servers on your machine at `http://host.docker.internal:PORT`, and note that STDIO comma
nds run inside the container, not on your machine.\n\nSee [Installation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#which-one-do-i-ne

ed) for the full comparison.

## 2. Connect a server

On first launch, MCPJam shows a **Welcome** overlay that guides you thro
ugh connecting your first server. You can:\n\n* **Enter your own server**: paste an HTTPS URL (e.g. `https://your-server.example/m
cp`) or a STDIO command (Terminal, Desktop, and Docker only).\n* **Try the Excalidraw demo**: a hosted diagramming MCP app, no set
up required.\n\nAfter connecting, MCPJam shows the server name and tool count, then offers an **Open Playground** button that seed

s the chat with the prompt:

```
What can this server do?
```

Press **Send** to explore your server's tools. No API key, ng

rok, or ChatGPT/Claude subscription needed.

> [!TIP]
>
> You should see your server show **Connected** and its tools listed i

n the Playground's left rail.

> [!TIP]
>
> Use the widget debug icons to open tool input/output, CSP activity, widget state,

and JSON-RPC for each result.

## 3. Connect your own server

Open the **Connect** tab in the left sidebar (labelled **Servers
** in some builds). Click **Add server**.\n\n* **HTTP**: Paste a URL ending in `/mcp`. The web app accepts **HTTPS** URLs only. Te
rminal, Desktop, and Docker accept **HTTP** or **HTTPS**; from Docker, use `host.docker.internal` for servers on your machine. Add
